Fiorella’s Cucina marks the beginning of a culinary journey that started in 2000, when Rémon Karian, just 23 years old, opened this restaurant with a vision and a modest budget.
Rémon's dream was to create a neighborhood hub, a place where the community could gather over plates of authentic Italian cuisine.
This was no easy task, yet Rémon's passion and commitment to quality paid off, turning Fiorella's into a beloved local fixture.
The story of Fiorella’s is not just about its founder, but also about resilience and community spirit.
